title: Ruchir Sharma: When Will the AI Bubble Burst?

excerpts.label: US economy is one big bet on AI
excerpts.insight: Outside AI, lots of weakness. 40% of growth from AI capex, 80% of stock gains from AI plays.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: US equity exposure = concentrated AI bet. Diversify internationally or hedge with puts.

excerpts.label: 60% of US growth driven by AI
excerpts.insight: Direct capex plus wealth effect powering top 10% spending. Productivity benefits still too early to measure.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Growth dependent on wealth effect loop. Break in AI stocks = consumer spending cliff.

excerpts.label: Most hated tech revolution—only 35% positive
excerpts.insight: Unlike past bubbles, people fearful not optimistic. Techno-optimists saying 'we're coming for your job' breeds fear.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Sentiment different from 1999—fear not euphoria. May limit retail FOMO, slower melt-up.

excerpts.label: Four O's of bubble: overinvestment, overvaluation, overownership, overleveraging
excerpts.insight: Tech capex at 5% GDP (2000 level), 52% household wealth in equities (higher than 2000), Meta/AMZN/MSFT now issuing debt for AI arms race.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Bubble checklist 3/4 complete. Watch corporate debt issuance as 4th shoe to drop.

excerpts.label: China AI convergence at 1/5 the cost—bubble bursts on rate hikes
excerpts.insight: Chinese LLMs at parity spending $100B vs US $500B. Every bubble pricked by one factor: interest rates going up.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: THE trigger = rate hikes. Monitor Fed rhetoric and inflation prints. China DeepSeek follow-ups = valuation risk.

excerpts.label: Quality stocks at historic discount—best time to buy
excerpts.insight: Quality factor (high ROE, low leverage) had one of worst 12-month runs in recorded history. Contrarian entry.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Rotate to quality factor NOW. Historic entry point. QUAL, SPHQ or custom screen.

excerpts.label: International outperformance is multi-year trend
excerpts.insight: 2025 not a flash in pan. These trends persist once they begin. Expect continuation in 2026.
excerpts.pm_takeaway: Underweight US, overweight EAFE/EM. Multi-year trend once started. Rebalance now.
